'''Aplasia''', officially the '''Republic of Aplasia''', is a country on the northwestern coast of New Ayre. [[Yondhu]] is the capital of Aplasia and is also the country's largest city. Aplasia is bordered by the [[Rianian Ocean]] to the north, the [[Etirhan]] province of [[Moaneill]] to the south and southeast, and [[Maalle]] to the west. It is part of The [[Demeeri]].

With a land area of 36,234 km2 (13,990 sq mi), Aplasia is the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|third-smallest sovereign state by area]] in mainland New Ayre after [[Elja and Munusia|Elja and Munisia]] and the [[Crila Republic]], and is the [[List of countries and dependencies by population|seventh-least populous]] sovereign state in New Ayre; it is also one of the [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|least densely populated countries]] on Andah. There are two official languages of the country, [[Lastnu Language|Lastnu]], the language of government, and [[Aplasian creole Language|Aplasian Creole]] as the language widely spoken, while a large part of the population is bilingual in both languages. Aplasia is the only country in mainland New Ayre to have [[Lastnu]] as the official language. It is part of the mainland [[North New Ayre]] area, maintaining strong cultural, historical, and political ties with other neighbouring countries.

It has a wide variety of natural habitats and very high [[wikipedia:Biodiversity|biodiversity]]. The country also hosts a part of the [[Seroasa rainforest]], one of the largest and most biodiverse [[wikipedia:Tropical_rainforest|tropical rainforests]] in the world. The region known as "the Demeeri" consists of a large shield landmass. Historically dominated by the [[Liokono]] and [[Kina tribe|Kina]] tribes, Aplasia was colonised by the [[Lycroa|Lycroans]] before coming under [[Emara|Emaran]] control in the mid 16th century. It was governed as [[Emaran Aplasia]] with a mostly [[wikipedia:Plantation_(settlement_or_colony)|plantation-style]] economy until the 1710s. It gained independence in 1718 and officially became a republic. The legacy of [[Ayuman colonialism]] is reflected in the country's political administration, lingua franca and diverse population, which includes [[Ztesh|Zteshi]], [[Dahe|Dahen]], [[Indigenous communities in Aplasia|Indigenous]], [[Emara|Emaran]], [[Lycroa|Lycroan]], and various multiracial groups.

In 1764, 21% of the population of Aplasia lived below the [[wikipedia:Poverty_threshold|poverty line]]. Aplasia's economy has been undergoing a transformation since the discovery of [[wikipedia:Petroleum|crude oil]] in 1750 and commercial drilling in 1761, with its economy growing by 21% in 1764, making it, by some accounts, currently the world's fastest-growing economy. Aplasia is poised to become one of the world's largest per capita oil producers by 1765, thanks to massive offshore oil discoveries. Since 1754, over .[[List of countries by proven oil reserves|18 billion barrels of oil reserves]] have been found off the country's coast. The oil production has made Aplasia a major participant in international energy trade in the early 1760s. Aplasia is now ranked as having the [[List of countries by GDP (PPP) per capita|highest GDP per capita]] in the world. According to the [[Global Trade Union]] in 1765, abject poverty still exists and the country faces significant risks in structurally managing its growth.
